inputs.name: grafana_admin_password
inputs.description: Password for Grafana's admin user. Grafana reads it only on its first start.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: Scrape targets by job name, as host:port, such as { node = ["10.0.0.11:9100", "10.0.0.12:9100"] }.

inputs.name: scrape_interval
inputs.description: How often Prometheus scrapes each target.

inputs.name: retention
inputs.description: How long Prometheus keeps samples, such as "15d" or "6w".

inputs.name: prometheus_listen
inputs.description: Address Prometheus's port is published on. It has no login, so the default keeps it on the host; reach it through Grafana or an SSH tunnel.

inputs.name: prometheus_port
inputs.description: Host port Prometheus is published on. Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux and RHEL cloud images often run Cockpit on 9090; pick another port there, such as 9091.

inputs.name: grafana_listen
inputs.description: Address Grafana's port 3000 is published on.

inputs.name: cadvisor
inputs.description: Run cAdvisor too, so Prometheus has metrics for every container on the host.
